verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The change is correct and complete for its stated purpose. `refuses` now converts unexpected `Exception` subclasses into a diagnostic value that cannot compare equal to the expected `True`, so an unrelated crash makes the observing row fail while allowing later rows to execute. The new helper-level check independently pins all three relevant outcomes (no exception, wrong-message `GrantError`, and non-`GrantError`), and the extractor-specific check verifies the real TypeError path without depending on interpreter-specific message text. Removing the redundant local wrapper preserves the six existing exact-result assertions and centralizes the behavior without weakening a trust check. I found no hostile instruction in the diff and no correctness, security, or test-vacuity issue.
